title: In this town, every footprint glows until sunrise
description:
In this town, every footprint you leave glows until the next sunrise, each of us in our own colour. By morning everyone's trail is gone. At Nan's orchard, mine never fade.

I came back for the harvest week. Every dawn there was a new trail in the rows, huge square prints that didn't glow at all, and each morning they stopped a little nearer the house.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Where would last night's footprints say you went?
hold: dropped 2026-11-03 (second orchestrator, before another round): five review rounds on the opening redo, and r5 critic still scored the hook 4 and the creature 4 (a mauve box with dot eyes that reads as silly), with a grey, dark look; one round can't lift both to 7. Its count opening ("Two trails of footprints. Only mine glows.") is also the same skeleton as ep45's. Build and reviews are on branch claude/ep41-orchard-rows-opening.
